reviews.t: I doesnt work good on long
reviews.x: This is really for men with very short spikey styles.  I doesnt work good on long hair

I bought this product for my daughter who has hair length just below her shoulders. We followed the instructions and it was so nasty.  Wiping it into her hair was really gross and made her hair feel like she had dreadlocks starting with soft hair. We let it dry the half hour like it says to and figured it would get better. Nope.  I spent another 30 minutes trying to comb it out because it was all clumped together. If felt like we had spent hours ratting her hair. After pulling out half her hair

This product is absolute crap. It does not come with instructions just a blurb about , AFTER The Net Hair (what net hair??) pull through from root to tip with fingers. After which I ended up looking like I had left actual hair dye in my hair. There is no flow after application but an unstylable sticky clumpy mess I pulled back in a ponytail and wore a baseball cap all day. Don't be fooled by the picture, it looks nothing like it after application. 10.99 in the trash. The consistency is like oile

reviews.t: DO. NOT. BUY. For the love of God don't
reviews.x: Absolutely terrible listen to the bad reviews! I saw this on Facebook and specifically got this brand for that reason. It's so bad and sticks together and it rips your hair out. ONLY good thing about it was it washed out with water and a little shampoo. I will NEVER buy this product again. It was a huge waste of money. It's now in a dump somewhere, 2 days after we got it it was thrown away.

reviews.t: So not white but still nice.
reviews.x: I just got this product today,  super excited to have white hair wax. Unfortunately it's not actually white it's more of a light silver. It's still looks nice but not the colour promised.

reviews.t: ... me a full refund when I reported I wasn’t happy with the product
reviews.x: Company gave me a full refund when I reported I wasn’t happy with the product. Thank you!

reviews.t: Ordered this as I've seen women with beautiful hair in ads for it
reviews.x: Ordered this as I've seen women with beautiful hair in ads for it, WELL no just no! I have long hair and tried applying it. It does not work well with long hair at all. I tried brushing it over and over to try for a "natural smooth look" it felt like I had a handful of thick gel in my hair. I let my ten year old use it since his hair is short and boys like the gel look. It worked great for him!
Horrible product. This is terrible for curly hair.

I bought this to use to cover my dark baby hairs under an Elsa wig for work.. I have dark brown hair and I was hoping since my wig is white that it would help blend it better..definitely DID NOT. It wound up getting super crusty and gross and just looked like I put white goop in my hair and didn’t hide the brown whatsoever. Super disappointed and wish I could return, but I waited too long to try it. Maybe I can find a different use for it, but trying to blend for wigs is not the way to go.

reviews.t: Ok... Doesn't work with black hair
reviews.x: I shoulda been able to guess but I just wanted to try and see it. I have black hair and I'm a male. I put the white mud cream in my hair as I was supposed to and it turned silver-grayish which made me look like an old man at 16 years old. Also the feeling was stiffy but it was only like that to me because I was just not enjoying the look and made me look old. If you have any other hair color than black it may work but don't bet on it if its on the darker shade of color.

Good color coverage. I have medium brown hair and this gave me nice silvery hair. I have mid back length thick hair and used about 2/3 of the contained. Brushing helped with the clumping. It did make my hair straw like. Washed out very easy and my hair was super soft after. Smelled fine, kind of like mens body spray. I was curious if I would be able to style it with this in, but didn't try that. Would definitely buy again.

In order to achieve that look I believe a whole lot of product is necessary. A lot more than what is provided here. If a lot of product was not used I believe the model has blonde hair to obtain that color. While the product is decent enough for the price charged, enough is not provided to cover a whole head of hair & provide the results shown.

reviews.t: It works but your hair is unmanageable
reviews.x: So with enough of the product, it will absolutely make your hair white. However, if you want to have any style, bounce, or even remotely touchable hair, this will not do it. This is basically a wax that makes your hair look and feel like you sprayed a full can of aquanet on it. Gross. Also you cannot return the product.

For all the seniors out there who have gray hair and hate it ... you can get this and rub some in your hands and rub through you hair and your gray now turns to a pretty white ... there is not need to use styling products with this ... and it washes right out the next day ... I love this product ...

Overall the product works, and it works really well. It does leave your hair very stiff, just as a warning, but it dyes the hair pretty decently too. My only problem with the product is I ordered white, and I believe I received Silver because my hair was nowhere near white, but perfectly silver.

Don't waste your time, at least with the white shade. My hair is light blonde and this didn't show up *at all*- just left my hair a stringy tangled mess. Very disappointed- it was for a Halloween costume, but this item can't be returned either. I'll never use it again. A complete waste.

The product didn't work for me. It didn't coat my hair follicles enough to mask my natural hair color. It just clumped in between the strands as i applied it. However it was very smooth consistency, washes out easily and left my hair feeling a little softer.

i like the product... it's a great color and gives my very dark hair a good white/silver look...  i have to use a good bit so my hair is stiffer than I like but overall I'm pleased and absolutely feel that its a good buy and delivers what it is supposed to.

With dark hair it's extremely hard to get wash out colors to show in my hair.  I was complemented by so many friends and family. Definitely will be trying some of the other colors as well. This was white and looks like a silvery blue, so cool!

Was not the product I ordered. Different labeling and boxing from the previous item I had ordered. Which I submitted re-order, so I’m confused. First product worked well, not this one. Again, not even the same product as advertise.

reviews.t: It holds up well and washes out easily.
reviews.x: I have a seizure disorder. I paired this with Jovinno styling hair wax for a Cruella Deville costume. After a rough night with seizures my hair was still pretty much what I started the night with. So...yep I recommend this wax.
This product is awesome , not sure y ppl say it doesn’t come out, put a good chunk in ur palm and scrunch up, the more u use the more vibrant the color. Used on myself and both my kids
I bought a white wax and didn't work on my brown/black hair; it's very hard and it doesn't leave your hair smooth. I would recommend watching some YouTube videos before buying it.
This product is DEFINITELY SILVER and NOT WHITE. It goes on and comes off easily, but it doesn't cover anywhere near like the stock images show. It also has a slight scent.
When I used this hair dye it did nothing to my hair but make it crispy. I thought it may take time to become more vibrant but it did not. If anything it became more dull.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the product leaves hair stiff, sticky, clumpy, or unmanageable.
Several reviewers say it does not work well on long hair.
Some reviewers say the color comes out silver or gray rather than white.
A few reviewers praise the color coverage on darker hair.
Some reviewers note it washes out easily.
